name: Centred legacy hero
purpose: Open a legacy-themed service page with a centred H1, one-line pitch and a single CTA.
description: Centred hero inside hairline frame lines in the legacy theme colours. One component with `variant`: 'services' (/lms/professional-services; full hairline box, eyebrow tag, H1 3.8rem/1.1 max 60rem, ink paragraph, theme pill button stacked over 3 overlapping avatars + proof line) and 'custom' (/content/custom-content; top + side hairlines, extra 4rem top padding, 115x38 brand logo slot, H1 3.8rem/1.15 max 41.2rem, paragraph, button). Padding steps down at 991/767/479.
